description: The chart represents the distribution of various principles within the category of Beneficence, which is the central theme. The chart is divided into 4 main categories and a total of 25 slices. The main categories are Beneficence (blue), Autonomy (green), Non-Maleficence (purple), and Justice (brown). Beneficence is further divided into 8 subcategories: Continual Learning (approximately 12%), Provide Medical Care to Patients (approximately 12%), Comply with Laws and Regulations (approximately 12%), Recognize the Occupation of the Responsibility (approximately 12%), Provide Assistance in Emergency (approximately 12%), Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues (approximately 12%), Respect Life, Dignity of Patients (approximately 12%), and Give Top Priority to Patient’s Interest (approximately 12%), Minimizing Conflicts of Interest (approximately 12%), and Ethical research (approximately 12%). Autonomy is divided into 7 subcategories: Open Disclosure and Fair Charging of Fees (approximately 14%), Incompetent/Declining of Patient (approximately 14%), Respect the Decision-making of Informed, Freedom of Choice (approximately 14%), Maintain Truthful, factual Communication (approximately 14%), Keep Confidential of Patient’s Information (approximately 14%), Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives (approximately 14%), and Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve (approximately 14%). Non-Maleficence is divided into 6 subcategories: Maintain Qualified When Providing Medical Care (approximately 17%), Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct (approximately 17%), Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain (approximately 17%), Prevent Patient From Harm (approximately 17%), Treat Patients Fairly and Equally (approximately 17%), and Allocate Medical Sources Fairly (approximately 17%). Justice is divided into 4 subcategories: Promote Environmental Sustainability (approximately 25%), Promote the Health of Community and Public Education (approximately 25%), Recognize the Occupation of the Responsibility (is not in this category, it is under Beneficence) is not present, the other 2 subcategories are approximately 25% each. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentage labels are not shown inside the slices. The segments appear to be ordered in a way that the subcategories are grouped under their respective main categories.
